mapper.sql: select d.draft_id, d.image_path, d.figure_path, d.ocr_text, d.confidence, d.predicted_type, d.predicted_difficulty, d.subject_id, s.subject_name, d.status, d.question_id, d.create_by, d.create_time, d.update_time, d.remark from edu_qb_ocr_draft d left join edu_subject s on s.subject_id = d.subject_id
mapper.select: select d.draft_id, d.image_path, d.figure_path, d.ocr_text, d.ocr_lines::text as ocr_lines, d.confidence, d.predicted_type, d.predicted_difficulty, d.predicted_options::text as predicted_options, d.subject_id, s.subject_name, d.status, d.question_id, d.create_by, d.create_time, d.update_time, d.remark from edu_qb_ocr_draft d left join edu_subject s on s.subject_id = d.subject_id where d.draft_id = #{draftId}
